name: Traffic Intelligence
description: Measures visitor volume, pageviews, session duration, device breakdown, and referral channels.

name: Search Intelligence
description: Tracks search query volume, SERP rankings, CTR, search intent, and organic impressions.

name: Content Intelligence
description: Audits published page counts, topic density, content completeness, and FAQ coverage.

name: Domain Intelligence
description: Monitors DNS records, WHOIS registration dates, SSL certificates, and subdomains.

name: People Intelligence
description: Tracks public author attributions, open-source maintainers, and public organization roles.

name: Company Intelligence
description: Monitors corporate profiles, product portfolios, technology stacks, and business scale.

name: Research Intelligence
description: Tracks published preprints, academic papers, citations, and scientific dataset releases.

name: Technology Intelligence
description: Monitors open-source GitHub repositories, npm package downloads, Web APIs, and frameworks.

name: Product Intelligence
description: Audits feature sets, pricing tiers, release notes, and user satisfaction signals.

name: Social Intelligence
description: Monitors public discussions, social media mention volume, and community sentiment shifts.

name: Community Intelligence
description: Tracks public forum activity (Reddit, Hacker News, Stack Overflow) and Q&A density.

name: Geographic Intelligence
description: Analyzes country-level traffic distribution, regional demand, and localization opportunities.

name: Economic Intelligence
description: Measures industry advertising CPC rates, monetization models, and market spend.

name: Knowledge Intelligence
description: Audits Wikipedia references, ontology term coverage, and technical documentation depth.

name: Authority Intelligence
description: Measures domain rating, backlink quantity/quality, and authoritative citation counts.

name: Trend Intelligence
description: Calculates signal velocity, acceleration, search interest spikes, and seasonal trends.
